title: Customizable text spacing for cognitive disability and dyslexia readability
statement:
Providing customizable text spacing, specifically allowing line-height to reach 1.5x and paragraph spacing to 2x, is essential for readability among users with cognitive disabilities and dyslexia.

Options:
- WCAG 2.1 Minimum Spacing: line-height: 1.5; margin-bottom: 2em; (fits: accessible web, government sites)
- Enhanced Spacing: line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 2.2em; (fits: educational content, dyslexia support)
- Horizontal Spacing Target: letter-spacing: 0.12em; word-spacing: 0.16em; (fits: learning management systems, reading apps)
- Dense UI Spacing: line-height: 1.2; (fits: data tables, dashboards)
appliesWhen: Applies to: web, digital documents. Audience: general, adults, children under 10.

source.title: WCAG 2.1 Specification: Success Criterion 1.4.12 Text Spacing
